desc:
Can your fortress survive the impact?

Pick a tank, bunker or building, protect your VIP, and challenge another player in casual PvP. Take turns firing at each other's defenses—every shot can change the battlefield.

💥 Watch projectiles squash, armor bend and explosions tear through structures.
🛡️ Earn coins to upgrade your fortress with stronger armor and extra protection.
🎯 Unlock different rounds and experiment with your aim and power.
🔬 Switch between Normal and Pressure views to examine each impact.
🏆 Take on campaign challenges or test projectiles in the material range.

Every defense has a weak point. Find theirs before they find yours.

This version has removed "Free-Form Creation"
